## Overview

::: {.htimeline .static}

### Medieval period {date="V^th^--XV^th^ century"}

### Early modern period {date="1492--1789"}

### Late modern period {date="1789--1945"}

### Contemporary period {date="1945--"}

:::

## Stepping through events

::: {.htimeline}

### Fall of Constantinople {date="1453-05-29"}

The box under the line accepts **any markdown**: lists, callouts, code,
figures… A lone image at the end goes into a column on the right.

![](images/landmark.svg)

### Storming of the Bastille {date="1789-07-14"}

::: {.incremental}
- Fragments *inside* a box
- run before the next event
:::

### Revolutions of 1848 {date="1848-02--1848-06"}

Month-only dates show the month above the year.

### Today {date="2000--" date-detail="*ongoing*"}

Open-ended ranges and a custom upper line with `date-detail`.

:::

## Options

::: {.htimeline .show-all}

### `.show-all` {date="1900"}

All dates and titles are visible from the start, dimmed; each step
highlights the next one.

### `.static` {date="1950"}

No steps at all, useful for an overview.

### `.first-visible` {date="2000"}

The first event is already shown when the slide opens.

:::
